items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: And you take like George Bockey, Jimmy Noon, Johnny Das, Sidney Veen. Oh, some of the clarinet players, man, had really good clarinet players here then.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you who was your favorite clarinet player when you were a young boy?

Well I'll tell ya. Well they had plenty of good clarinet players. Before I was playing, they had plenty of good clarinet players here. And you take like George Bockey, Jimmy Noon, Johnny Das, Sidney Veen. Oh, some of the clarinet players, man, had really good clarinet players here then.
